Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love this thing! The classic designs works extremely well. This bad boy does everything. It gets as hot as you will ever need, and works great for low and slow. The built-in thermometer is a great accessory too. I have used other charcoal grills owned by friends and family, but this one is far superior. Some of those cheaper grills don't have enough vertical space or will have paint bubble if your hot charcoal gets too close to the side. I've been using a pellet grill for the past decade and got a little bored and wanted to go the charcoal route. I also hated vacuuming that thing all the time too. Getting this Weber Kettle has renewed my love for grilling and I use it as often as I possibly can. This was the best purchase I've made in a long time!

Results.ReviewText:
I've owned a jumbo Joe for years now. I upgraded to a 22" copper kettle grill. And was disappointed that it didn't have the bail style lid holder, on my second use, trying to use the cheap hook under the lid. It didn't hook, and dropped hitting the ground. Damaging the lid. Now it doesn't seal good.
For the cost of the grill. The new cheap design is a waste of time and money.
Results.Title: Looks great. Poor function.

Results.ReviewText: Spent months debating which grill to buy. I was replacing a pellet grill that I had for about 7 years. Wasn’t sure if I should get another pellet, a komado style charcoal, a gas? Wood offset? So many options. After hundreds of YouTube videos I realized that many “pitmasters” were comparing their fancy cookers to the Weber kettle. Some even had videos where they used a kettle “just for old time sake”. Got me thinking… why buy a $700 - $1,500 grill or smoker when this gave comparable results for under $300? So I gave it a try. Man am I impressed! SO easy to use. And the smoke flavor it puts into the food is impressive. So far I’ve only cooked pork steaks, country style ribs, chicken breast/wings/thighs. But holy cow. I wish I bought this stead of my pellet grill way back when. Get it. You won’t be disappointed. I do wish that I went with the baskets to aid in indirect cooking but for shorter cooks of 1 hour or less I’m making due just fine.
Results.Title: Great decision

Results.ReviewText: It's a nice little grill when you have time. Not something good to use for tailgating or traveling with.
Results.Title: Tasty Food!!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been a charcoal and wood burning Weber user for over 20 years.  This unit is by far the best I’ve had. Thoughtful user features such as being able to hang the cooking rack on the rim, the app with two temperature prongs and the ambient temperature gauge on the hood add to the enjoyment and craft of cooking with wood and charcoal. Oh! And the ash collector is a huge advance over the tray in earlier models. No more stepping on hot coals in my bare feet!😄. I look forward to using the charcoal bins for indirect cooking, too.
Results.Title: Best yet!

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill Probably the nicest I've owned...but with a few flaws. First of all love the copper color, and how easy it was to put together. I owned barrel smokers before (premium ones) always a pain to clean the ash out, and they rust quick. This one is SOOO easy to clean the ash out...and the warranty of TEN years...I've paid a lot for a premium barrel smoker before that only had a year warranty. Also this is extremely efficient with how much charcoal you use to cook with! Now the flaws the charcoal grate on mine is rusting rather quickly only cooked on it 8times so I don't see that lasting (although the cooking grate seems like it will last)....and also the nuts that holds the handle on are stamped steel and not real nuts...probably going to replace them with real stainless and washers. Pretty happy with this grill....kinda like the cadillac of charcoal. It's built up an extremely loyal following over decades so you know that must mean something.
Results.Title: Wonderful...with a few flaws

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
